item.title: Dot Link 0.4.40
item.description: - Added optional Polar health context, with guided account connection in Healthcare settings. - Let Dot use shared sleep, activity, heart-rate and recovery information in everyday conversations and suggestions. - Improved answers that combine health, weather, location and other shared context. - Added five activity-intensity levels and clearer timing for heart-rate and activity records using your phone history when available. - Protected health-based replies when sharing stops or their source information is no longer current.
